about: One loaded Smith machine set (8 reps), frame by frame at 60 fps (camera 540x960 portrait, px). Per frame: [knee angle (deg), hip height, thigh length, thigh + shin, head height]. Knee, hip and lengths were read off the leg the app drew on a screen recording of the set (knee angle as a median of 3 frames, to smooth the line fit); null where the drawn leg was hidden under the app's own labels. Head height is the mean of nose and ears from the same pose model (lite) run on the recording, because the app doesn't draw the head.
